mapper.insert:
insert into notification_user_read_record (send_record_id, user_id, user_type, is_read, reply_status, send_status, student_user_id, create_time) values
(#{item.sendRecordId}, #{item.userId}, #{item.userType}, #{item.isRead}, #{item.replyStatus}, #{item.sendStatus}, #{item.studentUserId}, #{item.createTime})
mapper.select: select read_id, send_record_id, user_id, user_type, is_read, read_time, reply_status, reply_time, send_status, student_user_id, create_time from notification_user_read_record where send_record_id = #{sendRecordId}

select r.read_id as readId, r.user_id as userId, r.user_type as userType, r.is_read as isRead, r.read_time as readTime, r.reply_status as replyStatus, r.send_status as sendStatus, r.student_user_id as studentUserId, ps.student_name as studentName, ps.relation_desc as relation, r.create_time as createTime from notification_user_read_record r left join sys_parent_student_relation ps on r.user_id = ps.parent_user_id and r.student_user_id = ps.student_user_id where r.send_record_id = #{sendRecordId} and r.send_status = '0'
